periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, slanting downward towards the medial muzzle line at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval profile with a longitudinal axis approximately 1.6 times greater than the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering resulting in a teardrop-shaped extension that terminates near the lateral nasal boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broad U-shaped posterior curve with minimal vertical deviation across the spinal column.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High relative thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the visible longitudinal dorsal surface.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the inter-ear gap roughly equivalent to 2.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and hemispherical with no visible flattening or irregularities on the superior margin.
